title: On the Bach tensor and quadratic curvature functionals
summary: We study the critical points of a quadratic functional depending on the gradient of the Bach tensor on Riemannian four-manifolds, which generalize the Bach-flat condition. We show that, on every closed four-manifold, there exists a weak Bach-parallel metric, i.e. a critical point for this functional with respect to conformal variations: in particular, we prove that there exist infinitely many conformal classes which contain a unique minimizer for the functional, up to constant positive rescaling.
